title: Campaign 2 Kick: Emoji-First Command Layer
summary: Campaign 2 focuses on the emoji-first command layer: UI-aligned DSL for all inputs, quick-cast wheels + textless comms, a 90s emoji-only tutorial, and telemetry on command latency/accuracy.
context: Campaign 1 thin UI/HUD slice is closed; wired playtest evidence is mirrored under exchange/outbox/attachments/campaign1/. Proceed to Campaign 2 to make the UI run fully through the emoji DSL and capture command performance telemetry.

directives.details: Ack this order with owner + ETA for your Campaign 2 slice. Pull latest to ensure Campaign 1 closure and attachment evidence are present.
Route all UI inputs through the emoji DSL guardrails (quick-cast wheels + textless comms). Ensure HUD surfaces reflect DSL actions.
Build a replayable ~90s emoji-only tutorial aligned with the DSL. Teach core commands/abilities and log command latency/accuracy.
Instrument telemetry for command latency/accuracy and HUD signals (ui_state, revive, one_more_prompt, emoji_latency_sample). Run at least one playtest capturing these metrics.
Mirror evidence to hub (logs + tutorial artifacts), update ledger, and file a completion report with metrics and any blockers.

success_criteria: Owner + ETA posted for Campaign 2 per front
UI runs entirely through emoji DSL (quick-cast + textless comms) with guardrails
Telemetry captured for command latency/accuracy and HUD signals (ui_state, revive, one_more_prompt, emoji_latency_sample)
Evidence mirrored to hub; ledger + completion report filed
